answer: Mechanism: Beacon-Rotated Raven Trellis. Each epoch, a public VRF (drand) seeds a permutation over committed agent IDs after commitments close. It assigns each ID a unique DAG trellis slot and random peer cross-checks; a raven cohort is drawn by the same seed to audit. Sybils cannot precompute co-location or audits. Every fake ID must independently run its slot’s workload and answer cross-checks before deadline; failure forfeits accrued copper credits and next-epoch eligibility. Cost scales linearly per identity in compute, bandwidth, and credit risk; one response cannot serve many IDs.
